name: Ayashiro Kagari
source:
"Bathtub fairy. Gummy fuel. Conversations with flower bud apple (onomatopeia)."

Wataru's classmate who is a well-known painter. Whenever she starts painting, she forgets everything around her and completely concentrates only on painting. Kagari rarely shows her emotions and thus, it's often hard to understand what she's going to do next.
